ui.chat.attachments.pending_caption.role: caption under the composer chip row
ui.chat.attachments.pending_caption.note: The chips are staged, not sent. States the composer row is pending so a reader cannot mistake it for a sent file card.

ui.chat.attachments.file_meta.role: type and size line on a file card
ui.chat.attachments.file_meta.tone: machine facts, middle dot separator, no sentence
ui.chat.attachments.file_meta.note: Preserve the separator and both placeholders. type is a short uppercase extension (PDF, MD); size is a formatted byte count.

ui.chat.attachments.file_missing.role: existence verdict on a sent file card
ui.chat.attachments.file_missing.note: Shown when the origin path no longer exists on this machine. The retained-copy line follows it.

ui.chat.attachments.file_retained.role: retained-copy line under the missing verdict
ui.chat.attachments.file_retained.note: digest is the attachment store content address. Do not translate or shorten the digest placeholder.

ui.chat.attachments.file_unnamed.role: filename fallback on a file card
ui.chat.attachments.file_unnamed.note: Only when a document block carried no filename.
